name: @haruyuki/core
_comment: Inherited: this package's owning item had already finished, and the addition is pure -- the root and test-support entries behave exactly as before. It names the producer half of the frame contract, which the package root already documents as public, yet was reachable only by importing the root, which also pulls in the engine transport and its createRequire(import.meta.url) call. JSON has no comments, so the reason lives in this key, the same way the repository's own baseline manifests carry theirs.
